blocks.text: Docstring explains the grouping rationale and the pure-move nature. Imports bring in BackgroundTasks, _resolve_chat_or_404, chat_store, chat_workspace, memory_batch, and project_registry. The request model definitions and DEFAULT_CHAT_PAGE_LIMIT constant are all in this block.
blocks.title: Module docstring, imports, and request models

blocks.text: register_project_endpoint generates a control unit name, registers the project path, and returns the unique_name and root_path. projects() delegates to list_projects(). Both routes require authentication.
blocks.title: Project registration and listing

blocks.text: Validates that after_seq is not combined with limit/before_seq. Applies DEFAULT_CHAT_PAGE_LIMIT when no params are given. Tries the owner fast-path (chat_store.get_chat with the caller as owner_id); on FileNotFoundError falls back to resolve_chat_access. After fetching, strips author_id from messages when the workspace setting disallows attribution visibility for this requester.
blocks.title: Chat retrieval with owner fast-path and pagination

blocks.anchor: def append_message(chat_id: str, req: AppendMessageRequest, owner_id: str = Depends(require_auth)):
blocks.text: If the chat already exists for the caller, stays owner-scoped. If not, checks resolve_chat_access; if the resolved role is 'viewer' returns 403. If the chat does not exist at all (genuinely new), lets the caller become the owner. Always stamps author_id as owner_id (the acting user, not real_owner_id).
blocks.title: Message append with collaborator routing

blocks.text: get_batches lists all batches for the owner. estimate_batch calls chat_store.estimate_batch_context_tokens without a batch_id — it is a live cost preview before creation. create_batch, rename_batch, add_batch_member, unlink_batch_members, and delete_batch all delegate to memory_batch, translating FileNotFoundError to 404 and ValueError to 400. unlink_batch_members returns a dissolved sentinel when the batch collapses to ≤1 member.
blocks.title: Memory batch CRUD

gotchas: delete_chat is owner-only — the collaborator resolver is deliberately not used here
append_message stamps author_id as the caller (owner_id pre-resolution), not the chat owner
after_seq cannot be combined with limit or before_seq — the route returns 400 if both are present
unlink_batch_members returns {"dissolved": true, "id": batch_id} when the batch collapses to ≤1 member
how_it_works: Authentication is enforced by require_auth (Depends); _resolve_chat_or_404 is used for mutation routes that need to verify edit access
get_chat first tries the owner fast-path (single DB round-trip); only falls back to resolve_chat_access if that raises FileNotFoundError
Memory-batch routes delegate entirely to eo/memory_batch.py; chat routes delegate to eo/chat_store.py
DEFAULT_CHAT_PAGE_LIMIT=200 is applied server-side when no pagination params are given, so bare GET /api/chats/{id} never returns the whole chat
inputs: request bodies: CreateChatRequest, RenameChatRequest, LinkChatsRequest, AppendMessageRequest, CreateBatchRequest, etc.
outputs: JSON: chat objects, batch objects, project lists, operation status dicts
purpose: Groups the three related domains (project registry, persistent chat history, memory batches) in one module because chats belong to batches and batches belong to projects. Contains both /api/projects routes, all /api/chats CRUD, and all /api/batches CRUD. Several routes include optimisations from a DB-pool perf audit (pagination defaults, owner fast-path, after_seq fetch mode).
side_effects: Writes to chat_store (create, rename, append, delete)
Writes to memory_batch store (create, rename, add/remove members, delete)
BackgroundTasks for cache bookkeeping after get_chat responses
summary: FastAPI router for projects, persistent chats, and memory batches; a pure move from api/server.py with perf-audit fixes wired in.
